root_cause.text: `__disarm_kprobe_ftrace()` fails to check the `kprobe_ftrace_disabled` flag before performing ftrace operations, leading to a page fault when ftrace has been killed and a module containing kprobes is removed.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states, "This is because the kprobe on ftrace does not correctly handles the kprobe_ftrace_disabled flag set by ftrace_kill(). To prevent this error, check kprobe_ftrace_disabled in __disarm_kprobe_ftrace() and skip all ftrace related operations." The patch adds `if (unlikely(kprobe_ftrace_disabled)) { return 0; }` at the beginning of `__disarm_kprobe_ftrace()`.
